journeys.title: Journeys
journeys.explain: A journey holds all saves and savestates for one exact ROM. Each console chooses its own journey; viewing one here never changes a console.
journeys.empty: Set up journeys for a supported game in Rommancer Sync on your console. Its current saves will be preserved.
journeys.allExplain: Request “{{name}}” on the consoles you tick. Offline consoles wait to reconnect. Running games must close first. This is a one-time request, not a global selection.
journeys.duplicateExplain: Copy the last server checkpoint, keeping the original intact. Consoles keep their existing selections. Unsynced progress is not included.
journeys.noFiles: This journey has no checkpoints yet.
journeys.restoreExplain: Make this checkpoint the journey's latest progress. Current progress stays in history. Consoles receive it when they can safely apply it.
journeys.restoreConflict: Progress changed during restoration. Both checkpoints were preserved; refresh and try again.

status.waiting: Waiting for game to close / local confirmation

dashboard.title: Collection
dashboard.noData: No databases imported yet. An administrator must import DATs in Administration.

missing.title: Missing roms
missing.exclude: Exclude protos, betas, demos, pirates and unlicensed

lists.title: Lists
lists.deriveHelp: For each game the rom that best matches the preferences is chosen.

layouts.rom-core: Next to the rom, folder per core
layouts.rom-saves: Saves folder next to the roms
layouts.beside: Next to each rom, in any folder

empty.title: Connect your first console
empty.intro: How will it connect? Pick one and you get only its steps.

app.title: The console syncs by itself
app.pitch: A small app on the console syncs over WiFi, in the background and around each game.
app.summary: Rommancer Sync goes on the console and syncs over WiFi by itself.
app.appears: The console shows up here as soon as it syncs.
app.viaSsh: Does the console have SSH? The server can install the app for you.

pc.title: Through your computer
pc.pitch: Put the console’s SD card in your computer, or plug the console in by USB. For consoles without WiFi, and to look after all of them from one place.
pc.summary: The Rommancer app on your computer syncs every console whose card you put in it.
pc.install: Install the Rommancer app on your computer.
pc.signIn: Sign in with this server’s address:
pc.insert: Put the console’s SD card in the computer, or plug the console in by USB as a drive. The app finds it under “Cards & folders”.
pc.link: Choose “Link as a new device”. From then on it syncs every time you put that card in.
pc.allConsoles: One app looks after all your consoles: each card remembers which console it belongs to. A card from a console that already syncs over WiFi is linked to that same console. Android consoles over USB don’t work: they use their own app.
pc.local: Is the card in this server instead?
pc.localAdd: Add it as a local folder

ssh.title: Over SSH, with nothing installed
ssh.pitch: The server logs into the console and copies the saves when you ask. Needs SSH on the console.
ssh.summary: The server logs into the console over SSH and copies the files itself. Nothing is installed on the console.
ssh.on: Turn on SSH on the console and note its IP address.
ssh.add: Add the console with its IP, user and password.
ssh.test: Press Test: it lists the roms folders it finds.
ssh.sync: Press Sync saves whenever you want them copied.
ssh.logins: root / linux on Knulli and Batocera, ark / ark on ArkOS, root with no password on Onion. For others, look in your firmware’s documentation.

install.label: On the console
install.pc: Nothing: the app is on your computer

when.label: When it syncs
when.pc: When you put its card in the computer

what.label: What it syncs
what.app: Saves, list games, settings, games to send
what.pc: Saves, list games, settings, games to send
what.ssh: Saves, and list games when you copy them

needs.label: Needs
needs.pc: A card reader or a USB cable
needs.ssh: SSH, and the console on the same network

ahead.help: This console’s app is newer than the one Rommancer {{version}} hands out: it was installed from elsewhere. It keeps working; what it needs from a newer server stays hidden until the server is updated (Administration > Update).

upload.title: Upload roms
upload.help: Only roms whose hash matches the database (No-Intro, Redump, registered romhacks) or RetroAchievements are accepted. The hash is checked in the browser before uploading.
upload.drop: Drop files here or click to choose
upload.tooBig: Too big to check in the browser; validated on the server

profile.mustChange: The initial password must be changed before continuing.
profile.passwordRule: Different from the current one and from the initial one.
profile.title: Profile
profile.credentialsHelp: Stored encrypted. If empty, the server global ones are used.

admin.label: Label
admin.batch: {{count}} DATs queued; showing the last one
admin.seedHelp: Saves to the seed/ folder the imported DATs, RetroAchievements hashes and scraped data (metadata and media). Deploying another instance with that folder loads everything on startup without downloading it again.

prune.title: Roms that are in no list
prune.label: Delete from the console the roms that are not in its lists
prune.help: When it syncs, the console deletes the roms that belong to none of its lists. The ones the server lacks are uploaded first (if the console lets the server fetch games). Saves stay. Ports, apps and BIOS are never touched. The console has the last word: a change made here is asked there.
prune.remoteOn: Pending: the console will ask its user whether to keep it the next time Rommancer is opened on it.
prune.remoteOff: Pending: the console will turn it off at its next sync.
prune.planOn_one: {{count}} rom ({{bytes}}) of the {{total}} on the console is deleted.
prune.planOn_other: {{count}} roms ({{bytes}}) of the {{total}} on the console are deleted.
prune.planOff_one: Turned on, it would delete {{count}} rom ({{bytes}}) of the {{total}} on the console.
prune.planOff_other: Turned on, it would delete {{count}} roms ({{bytes}}) of the {{total}} on the console.
prune.upload_one: {{count}} ({{bytes}}) is not on the server: it is uploaded before it is deleted.
prune.upload_other: {{count}} ({{bytes}}) are not on the server: they are uploaded before they are deleted.
prune.stuck_one: {{count}} is not on the server and cannot be uploaded (the console does not let the server fetch games, or the upload failed): it stays.
prune.stuck_other: {{count}} are not on the server and cannot be uploaded (the console does not let the server fetch games, or the upload failed): they stay.
prune.noInventory: The console has not sent its inventory yet.
prune.held: Stopped: {{count}} of the {{total}} roms (more than half) were about to be deleted. A list may have been emptied.
prune.heldKeep: Keep them (turns deleting off on this console)

bulk.title: Add games in bulk
bulk.help: Every game you have of the systems you pick, in the version of the regions you tick. For example, every European Game Boy and NES game.
bulk.best: One version per game (the best fit)

derive.help_filters: The same entries, in the version you ask for. See how many games have it before going on.
derive.help_resolve: These games do not have the version you ask for. Choose what to do with each.
derive.help_review: This is how the sublist will be. Refreshing it repeats these decisions.
derive.regionsHint: The version must be from one of these ("World" ones always count).
derive.unknown_one: {{count}} unknown file stays as it is
derive.unknown_other: {{count}} unknown files stay as they are
derive.restSkip_one: Leave out the remaining one too
derive.restLike_one: For the remaining one, add the version most like this one (or whatever there is)
derive.restLike_other: For the {{count}} remaining, add the version most like this one (or whatever there is)
derive.reviewMatched_one: {{count}} game in the version asked for
derive.reviewMatched_other: {{count}} games in the version asked for
derive.reviewRuleLike: the others without that version get the one most like the chosen one
derive.reviewRuleSkip: the others without that version are left out

fav.listHelp: Your favourite roms. Star a rom (or add it here) and it is in; remove it and it is out. It can go to your consoles like any other list.

ra.title: Your RetroAchievements
ra.help: With your RetroAchievements user and Web API key (free, on your RA account settings page) your progress in each game is read.
ra.notSet: Set your RetroAchievements user and Web API key in "External service credentials".

config.settingsHelp: Rommancer puts them on your consoles for you: through their app, over SSH or when their card is synced on a computer. Passwords are stored encrypted and never shown again.
config.raHelp: Checked with RetroAchievements when saved. Knulli needs the password itself; the others get the token RetroAchievements gives.
config.raConnectedHelp: Your consoles get this account. The password is stored encrypted and not asked for again.
config.raDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect RetroAchievements? Consoles keep what they already have but stop getting changes.
config.wifiHelp: The default network is the one your consoles try first; the others follow, in this order. Networks a console already has are kept; 5 GHz networks are not sent to consoles that only see 2.4 GHz.
config.bandHelp: If your router uses the same name on both bands, keep "2.4 and 5 GHz". If it is a 5 GHz-only network, say so: many handhelds (the Miyoo Mini Plus, for one) cannot see it.
config.hiddenLong: Hidden network (does not broadcast its name)
config.wifiEmpty: No networks yet. Add your home one and the ones you use elsewhere: all your consoles will get them.
config.wifiDefault24: Consoles without 5 GHz cannot see it and start with "{{ssid}}"
config.wifiDefaultNo24: Consoles without 5 GHz cannot see it, and have no other network
config.wifiAdded: "{{ssid}}" added: your consoles get it when they sync
config.wifiRemoveConfirm: Remove "{{ssid}}"? Consoles delete it at their next sync.
config.wifiFromComputer: Want to bring in the networks your computer already knows? Do it from the Rommancer desktop app (a browser cannot read them).
config.unsupported: Rommancer does not know where this firmware keeps its configuration yet. For now: Knulli, Batocera, Onion, muOS, ROCKNIX, ArkOS, NextUI and Android.
config.android: On Android WiFi networks are added from the Rommancer app ("Add my WiFi networks"). RetroAchievements goes into RetroArch and PPSSPP: those that keep their configuration in Android/data need Shizuku running on the console (the app explains it).
config.keep: Keep my settings up to date (RetroAchievements and WiFi networks)
config.pending: There are changes to apply: they go in at the next sync.
config.leftOut: Not sent because this console cannot see them: {{list}}
config.clockOff: This console does not set its clock from the internet. With a wrong clock it cannot reach the server (it refuses its certificate) and dates saves wrongly.
config.clockOn: Set the time from the internet and wait for it at power-on
config.clockPending: It will be turned on at the console's next sync.
config.queued: Queued: done at its next sync
config.channels: Done by the console app when it syncs, by the server over SSH when the console is quiet, or by the desktop app when it syncs its card (the card does not reach internal memory, like Onion's WiFi). Never while a game is open. New networks are used after the console restarts.
config.copiesHelp: A copy is kept before every change. Open any of them, change a file and send it, or put the whole copy back on the console.
config.noCopies: No copies yet. Press "Copy its configuration".
config.pickFile: Pick a file to view or change it.
config.saveSend: Save and send to the console
config.note_raNoPassword: the RetroAchievements password is missing (Knulli needs it)
config.note_wifiFull: only 3 named networks fit; left out: {{detail}}
config.note_wifiInternal: WiFi lives in the console's internal memory: its app or SSH sets it, not the card
config.note_copyGone: the copy to restore no longer exists
config.note_unsupported: Rommancer does not know where {{detail}} keeps its configuration yet
config.note_unreachable: the card does not reach {{detail}}: the console or SSH restores it
config.note_raInternal: RetroAchievements lives in the console's internal memory: its app or SSH sets it, not the card
config.note_needShizuku: some emulators keep their configuration in Android/data: turn on Shizuku in the console's Rommancer app
config.note_noEmulators: no RetroArch or PPSSPP configuration found (open them once so they create it)
config.note_tooBig: {{detail}} is larger than 4 MB and was not copied
config.note_raAuthenticate: no RetroAchievements token: open NextUI Settings and press "Authenticate" once
config.note_wifiOneAtBoot: from the card only one network can be left ({{detail}}): ArkOS imports it at boot if it is in range. The console adds the rest when it syncs

organize.help: Patches, saves and cheats with the same name move with their rom. Multi-file games (cue/bin, gdi, m3u) are left alone. Every run is written down: a cut one is finished next time, and it can be undone.
organize.undoneSome: {{count}} files put back; these could not go back:
organize.companionOf: goes with {{rom}}, which did move: they are now in different folders
organize.readOnly: Rommancer may not write in this folder. To sort it, allow writing in it first (Edit, untick read-only).

problems.conflict: Another rom would end up with the same name, so neither was touched.
problems.exists: There is already a file with that name where it would go. Neither was touched.
problems.taken: Another file is now in its original place, so it was left where it is.
problems.permission: Rommancer is not allowed to write there. Check the folder permissions on the server.
problems.full: The disk is full. Free some space and apply again.
problems.missing: The file is no longer where it was. Scan the folder again.

space.title: Space on the console
space.numbers: {{free}} free of {{total}} · {{need}} still to copy (space reported {{when}})
space.unknown: The console has not reported its free space yet (it does at its next sync).
space.noFit: What is left to copy does not fit: {{over}} too much. What fits is copied, in list order; the rest waits until you choose.
space.shortfall: At the last copy {{files}} files ({{bytes}}) were left out for lack of space ({{when}}).
space.treeTitle: What to copy to this console
space.treeTotal: {{need}} of the ticked items still to copy · {{budget}} fits without touching the reserve
space.listNoFit: Not everything in its lists fits on {{device}}: {{over}} too much. What fits is copied in order.

storage.offlineWhy: Unavailable ({{reason}}) since {{when}}. Its index is kept untouched and nothing is written here.

reason.other-volume: another disk is in its place

storage.confirmRemoval: Were those files really deleted? They will be removed from the index.
storage.disk: {{free}} free of {{total}} on the disk · here {{here}}
storage.readOnlyLabel: Read-only: Rommancer never writes to this folder
storage.folderSystemsHelp: Say which system a subfolder belongs to when its name does not tell (e.g. "misc" → Super Nintendo).

setup.title: Storage setup
setup.intro: Where your roms are and where new ones go. Your folders are read as they are (Rommancer neither moves nor renames anything there); it only writes to folders you pick as destinations, always keeping the free space you ask for.
setup.sourcesHelp: Browse and add the folders where you already have roms (messy, in subfolders or on several disks is fine).
setup.container: Rommancer runs in a container: it only sees the folders mounted into it. To use another disk, add its folder to the compose volumes and restart; it will show up here.
setup.nothing: No roms that could be assigned to a system were found.
setup.unknown: Folders with no recognised system: tell which one (or ignore them)
setup.destHelp: New roms (uploads, games fetched from consoles) go to a destination. Use a general folder for everything and, for some systems, one of your folders.
setup.reserve: Free space kept on every disk (%)
setup.readOnlyNote: Folders that are not destinations stay read-only: Rommancer will never write there.
setup.overlap: This folder is inside another one already added (or contains it): {{path}}
setup.same: It is the same folder as {{path}}, mounted elsewhere: update its path instead of adding it
setup.banner: Rommancer does not know yet where your roms are.
setup.bannerNoDest: There is no destination folder: new roms have nowhere to go.

services.title: Connected services
services.help: Each service says whether it is connected and with which account. Passwords and keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.
services.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect {{name}}? The saved details of that account are deleted.
services.raConnectHelp: Your retroachievements.org user and password. They are checked when connecting, and your consoles get them to earn achievements.
services.raDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect RetroAchievements? Your user, password and Web API Key are deleted from Rommancer. Consoles keep what they already have.
services.raConsolesOk: Password checked: your consoles sign in with this account.
services.raConsolesMissing: Your password is missing: without it your consoles earn no achievements.
services.raKeyMissing: The Web API Key is missing: with it games with achievements are marked and you see your progress in each.
services.raKeyOk: RetroAchievements accepted the Web API Key
services.ssHelp: Your screenscraper.fr account: box art and videos of your games are downloaded with it.
services.tgdbHelp: Your TheGamesDB API key, to complete game details.
services.ssStep2: Confirm it with the link they email you.
services.ssStep3: Enter here the same username and password you use on their site. Rommancer tries them before keeping them.
services.tgdbStep1: Create an account on the TheGamesDB forum
services.tgdbStep2: Signed in, open your API keys page
services.tgdbStep3: Copy your public API key and paste it here. Rommancer tries it before keeping it.
services.ssNoDevId: ScreenScraper only answers apps that have a developer id, and this server doesn't have one yet. Your account is saved and will work once it does. The person who runs Rommancer asks for the id once:
services.ssDevStep1: Sign in to ScreenScraper and open a new topic in its developer forum
services.ssDevStep2: Say what the app is: Rommancer, a self-hosted manager for roms and saves that downloads game covers and details. They reply with a developer id and password.
services.ssDevStep3: Add both to the server's .env file and restart Rommancer:
services.works: Works: the service accepts your details.

guides.title: Guides & downloads
guides.intro: Rommancer is installed on each console to sync saves, receive the games of your lists and send the ones you lack. These are the consoles that work today; pick yours and follow the steps.

knulli.title: Knulli / Batocera
steps: Download the package: it already carries your server and account.
Unzip it on the card's SHARE partition (or the share folder over the network).
On the console: Tools → Rommancer Sync. It links itself.
Done: it syncs in the background from power-on.

onion.title: Onion (Miyoo Mini)
steps: Download the package: it already carries your server and account.
Unzip it at the root of the SD card.
On the console: Apps → Rommancer Sync. It links itself.
Done: it syncs at power-on and in the background.

arkos.title: ArkOS / dArkOS
steps: Download the package: it already carries your server and account.
Unzip it on the card's EASYROMS partition.
On the console: Start → Options → Tools → Rommancer Sync. It links itself.
Done: it syncs at power-on and before and after each game. WiFi must be on.

nextui.title: NextUI
steps: Download the package: it already carries your server and account.
Unzip it at the root of the SD card.
Turn WiFi on in NextUI's settings.
On the console: Tools → Rommancer Sync. It links itself and syncs in the background from then on.

android.title: Android
steps: Download the APK on the console and install it (allow this source if asked).
Open Rommancer Sync, grant file access and sign in.
Saves go up as soon as you save; the app updates itself.

pc.title: PC app
steps: Download and install the app for your system.
Sign in: it stays in the tray.
Insert a card or add a folder and link it to a device.

sd.title: Cards without network (DS, GBA flashcarts…)
steps: Install the PC app.
Insert the card in the PC: it shows up by itself.
Add it choosing its console and layout (TWiLight Menu++, GBA flashcart…).
Every time you insert it, it syncs: saves, its lists' games and what you ask for here.

linux.title: Other Linux consoles (terminal)
steps: Open a terminal on the console (or log in over SSH).
Run this command: it shows a code.
Approve the code in Devices → Link.

ssh.title: SSH only
steps: Devices → Add over SSH (admins).
Give its IP, user and password the first time.
The server installs the client and keeps it up to date.

excluded.title: Systems copied to this device
excluded.help: Every system in the subscribed lists. Untick those you do not want on this device; saves still sync.
excluded.newAuto: Copy new systems added to these lists automatically
excluded.newAutoHelp: When unticked, a system that appears in the lists later arrives unticked and is not copied until you tick it.

offline.help: Syncs when its card is connected to a computer with the app: what you see is from the last connection and what you ask for happens at the next one.

desktop.help: Syncs SD cards and folders from the computer (DS and consoles without network), copies games and assigns lists. Stays in the tray.

activity.offline: console offline, will carry on when back
activity.stopCopy: Cancel the copy? What is left is not sent to the server; the file being sent finishes.
activity.stopJob: Cancel this job? If it is running it stops at its next step, and what it did so far stays.

copyPick.title: Copy to the server
copyPick.help: Games on this console your collection lacks, by platform. Hacks and translations are stored with the game they come from. Unidentified files don't count for the collection and start unticked.
copyPick.where: Where they would go, by the server's destination folders
copyPick.diskLine: Disk: {{used}} in use of {{total}} · {{left}} would be left free
copyPick.unplaced_one: {{count}} file ({{size}}) fits in no destination folder. Untick platforms, free some space, lower a reserve or register another folder.
copyPick.unplaced_other: {{count}} files ({{size}}) fit in no destination folder. Untick platforms, free some space, lower a reserve or register another folder.
copyPick.noTarget_one: {{count}} file ({{size}}) is of a system with no destination folder and no general one.
copyPick.noTarget_other: {{count}} files ({{size}}) are of systems with no destination folder and no general one.

hero.title_one: This console has {{count}} new game that would help your collection
hero.title_other: This console has {{count}} new games that would help your collection
hero.lastCopy: Last copy from this console, finished {{when}}: {{done}} of {{total}} files reached the server
hero.waitingConsole: Waiting for the console to send the next one…
hero.offline: The console is not connected (last seen {{when}}). It will carry on by itself as soon as it is back.
hero.offlineSsh: The console does not answer (last seen {{when}}). The server will retry over SSH and carry on as soon as it finds it.
hero.cancelConfirm: Cancel what is left to copy? What was already copied stays.
hero.pausing: Finishing this file, then it stops.

ssh.help: For consoles without the app: the server installs the client over SSH and syncs it from then on
ssh.intro: The server logs into the console, installs the Rommancer client and runs a first sync. Afterwards it keeps it up to date over SSH whenever the console does not do it by itself.
ssh.server: Server address the console will use (optional)
ssh.keyHelp: Without a password: first add this key to the console's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys. With a password, the server installs the key itself and forgets the password.
ssh.installed: Client installed and first sync done

syncState.behind: The console does not have what its lists ask for yet:
syncState.toCopy_one: {{count}} game still to copy ({{size}}). It is copied when you open Rommancer on the console and choose Sync.
syncState.toCopy_other: {{count}} games still to copy ({{size}}). They are copied when you open Rommancer on the console and choose Sync.
syncState.downloading: Copying to the console now: {{done}} of {{total}}.
syncState.toDelete_one: {{count}} rom in no list will be deleted at its next sync (in a few minutes).
syncState.toDelete_other: {{count}} roms in no list will be deleted at its next sync (in a few minutes).
syncState.toDeleteOffline_one: {{count}} rom in no list will be deleted when it connects again.
syncState.toDeleteOffline_other: {{count}} roms in no list will be deleted when it connects again.
syncState.quiet: No contact since {{when}}. If it is on, it cannot reach the server: what you play stays on the console and goes up when it connects again.
syncState.conflicts_one: {{count}} save in conflict waits for you to choose which one counts.
syncState.conflicts_other: {{count}} saves in conflict wait for you to choose which one counts.
syncState.clock: This console does not set its clock from the internet: turn it on in the configuration tab.

device.refreshAsked: Asked: the console will send its list within seconds
device.sshAsked: The server is connecting to the console over SSH
device.listHelp_one: A new list with the game this console has, whether or not the server has it.
device.listHelp_other: A new list with the {{count}} games this console has, whether or not the server has them.
device.listUnknown_one: {{count}} of them no database identifies (a hack, a translation or another file): it goes in as unknown, by its name and content.
device.listUnknown_other: {{count}} of them no database identifies (hacks, translations or other files): they go in as unknown, by their name and content.
device.listDropped_one: {{count}} file of the console did not go into the list.
device.listDropped_other: {{count}} files of the console did not go into the list.
device.sendHelp: Pick games of the collection: they go to this console's own list, which it downloads by itself.
device.pullDisabled: This console does not let the server fetch games (changed in its app).
device.noInventory: It has not sent its list yet: press 'Refresh now'.
device.listPending_one: {{count}} still to copy to the console
device.listPending_other: {{count}} still to copy to the console
device.listCollections: Show the lists as collections in the frontend
device.listCollectionsHelp: Each list given to the console shows up as a collection in ES-DE, EmulationStation or Pegasus. Turning it off makes the console remove those collections at its next sync. The ones for games with saves and new games stay.
device.removeList: Remove the list from this console
device.chooseListsHelp: The console copies the games of the ticked lists. Removing a list does not delete games already copied to the console, unless you turn on deleting roms in no list below.
device.removeListsTitle_one: Remove the list "{{names}}" from this console?
device.removeKeeps: No rom is deleted: the games already on the console stay. The console just stops getting this list's games.
device.removeNothing: No rom is deleted: all its games are still in other lists of the console.
device.removeNoInventory: This console deletes roms in no list, but it has not sent what it holds yet: how many would go cannot be known.
device.removeDeletes_one: {{count}} rom will be deleted from the console ({{size}}). The server has a copy.
device.removeDeletes_other: {{count}} roms will be deleted from the console ({{size}}). The server has a copy of all of them.
device.removeDeletesLater_one: And {{count}} more ({{size}}) will be deleted once the server has copied it from the console.
device.removeDeletesLater_other: And {{count}} more ({{size}}) will be deleted once the server has copied them from the console.
device.removeStuck_one: {{count}} rom stays on the console because the server cannot copy it.
device.removeStuck_other: {{count}} roms stay on the console because the server cannot copy them.
device.noRoms: The console sent an empty list: there are no games in {{dir}}. Android app 0.9.19 or later finds ES-DE's folder or a ROMs folder on the SD card by itself: update it and sync. You can also set it in Devices › Edit › Roms folder, as a full path (for example /storage/XXXX-XXXX/ROMs).

listUpload.help: Drop roms anywhere on the page: new ones are stored in the collection, ones you already have are not uploaded, and all of them are added to this list.
listUpload.dropHere: Drop to add to the list

listDevices.help: Checked consoles keep this list: they download the roms they lack by themselves.
listDevices.copyHelp: One-off copy to an SD card or SSH device:

link.title: Link a device
link.help: Enter the code that Rommancer Sync shows on the console or PC.
link.done: "{{name}}" is linked. The console will start syncing in a few seconds.
link.installerHelp: Zip with Rommancer Sync already linked to your account: unzip it on the SD card (or the share folder) and open the app once. One console per download.

session.title: Session length
session.help: Days a session signed in with "Keep me signed in" lasts, counted from its last use (at least {{min}}). Without it, it lasts until the browser closes.

more.signupOpenHelp: Anyone can create a (non-admin) account from the web or from Rommancer Sync.
more.saveHistoryHelp: Versions the server keeps of each save, and copies each console keeps of what a sync overwrote on it. The version each console holds is never removed.

perms.title: Permissions
perms.roms.download: Download roms and copy to devices

game.removeRom: Remove this rom from the collection
game.removeConfirm: This game's files are deleted from the server and it leaves every list. Consoles keep what they downloaded and saves are untouched. Continue?
game.removeRomConfirm: This rom's file is deleted from the server and it leaves every list. Continue?
game.tryHelp: Try the game in an emulator in the browser, with no save. Nothing you do there is kept.
game.makePatch: Create BPS patch from the file (allows regenerating it)
game.splitHelp: The selected roms become another game. The decision is kept in future groupings.

works.title: Work
works.none: No works yet. They are created when Wikidata is synchronised.

upload.baseRom: Base rom (the one the hack comes from)
upload.searchRom: Type part of the rom name
upload.unverifiedHelp: For roms that are in no database (homebrew, hacks, translations). They are marked as unverified and do not count in percentages. If a later DAT includes them, they become verified.
upload.name: File name (optional)
upload.author: Author

paths.targetHelp: Uploads, patched roms and verified RVZ go to their destination path. Without a destination or default, DATA_DIR/library is used.

profile.noSs: Without your own ScreenScraper account no media is downloaded for your lists.
profile.credentialsHelp: Stored encrypted. Only your own accounts are used.
profile.raSameUser: It is the same user as in "Settings for your consoles": typing it once is enough.
profile.raKeyWhere: Where do I get the Web API Key?
profile.raKeyIntro: It is free and read-only: with it Rommancer loads the achievements catalogue and your progress in each game. It is not your password.
raKeySteps: Sign in at retroachievements.org (create an account if you have none; it is free).
Open your control panel (the button below goes straight there).
Find the "Keys" section and copy the "Web API Key" value.
Paste it here next to your user and press Save.
profile.raKeyNote: For your consoles to earn achievements your password is needed too, in "Settings for your consoles" (below): the key cannot sign in to emulators.

devices.agentHelp: The device syncs by itself: it fetches the save when a game starts and uploads it when it ends. The root is the path as the device sees it (e.g. /storage/emulated/0 or /userdata).
devices.scriptsHelp: A new token is generated; the previous one stops working.
devices.mountedHelp: If it is an SD card mounted on the server and sync is enabled, it syncs when connected.

saves.conflictsAlert: {{count}} saves were changed both on the server and on a device. Choose which one to keep.
saves.sharedHelp: Saves the users of this server have made public. Copy one into yours and it reaches your consoles at the next sync.
saves.noShared: Nobody has shared a save yet.
saves.cardsHelp: Your consoles' memory cards. Each save inside a card syncs on its own; a card is only rewritten while no emulator runs, and a copy of every image read or sent is kept.
saves.noCards: No console has sent a memory card yet.
saves.cardWaiting: Sent; waiting for the console to confirm it
saves.shareHelp: Every user of the server can see it on the game page and copy it into their saves. It stays in the history even if you keep playing.
saves.imported: Copied. It reaches your consoles at the next sync.
saves.importHelpState: Savestates only load in the same emulator ({{emulator}}). Whatever you have in that slot goes to the history.
saves.importHelpSave: Replaces your save of this game (yours stays in the history), converted to your emulator's format.
saves.coreWarning: Made with core version {{version}}; {{devices}} has another one and it may not load.
saves.playHelp: Opens the save in an emulator in the browser. Nothing you do there is kept.
saves.playStateHelp: Opens the savestate in an emulator in the browser (it only loads when its core is compatible with the console one). Nothing you do there is kept.
saves.onlyPlayedHelp: Saves that never changed after the game created them and automatic savestates (.state.auto) are hidden. Savestates you make always show.

status.pending: gets it at its next sync
status.conflict: conflict: choose which version to keep
status.incompatible: uses another emulator: this savestate is of no use there

sync.title: External sources synchronisation
sync.help: A scheduled task goes through the sources one after another and only downloads what changed. Then it rematches files, regroups games and exports the seed.
sync.tooSoon: That source was just synchronised; wait a few minutes

defaultLocale.title: Default language
defaultLocale.help: Language for new accounts and for visitors who have not chosen one. Existing users keep theirs.

pulls.asked_one: {{count}} file the server lacked was asked from your consoles; it arrives at their next sync.
pulls.asked_other: {{count}} files the server lacked were asked from your consoles; they arrive at their next sync.
pulls.off_one: {{count}} file is only on consoles that do not let the server fetch roms: it cannot be fetched.
pulls.off_other: {{count}} files are only on consoles that do not let the server fetch roms: they cannot be fetched.
pulls.denied_one: {{count}} file the server lacks cannot be asked from your consoles: your account cannot upload roms.
pulls.denied_other: {{count}} files the server lacks cannot be asked from your consoles: your account cannot upload roms.
pulls.nowhere_one: {{count}} file is neither on the server nor on any of your consoles.
pulls.nowhere_other: {{count}} files are neither on the server nor on any of your consoles.
pulls.noSystem_one: {{count}} file is not a game of any system and the server does not accept unknown files (Admin › Rom paths): it stays in the list, but is not kept.
pulls.noSystem_other: {{count}} files are not games of any system and the server does not accept unknown files (Admin › Rom paths): they stay in the list, but are not kept.

unknownFiles.title: Accept unknown files
unknownFiles.help: What a console holds that is not a game of any system (app shortcuts, launchers) is kept in the library's "unknown" folder, so lists can take it to other consoles, into the same folder.

setup.dbTitle: Choose where to keep the data
setup.dbBundled: The database that comes with Rommancer (recommended)
setup.dbBundledHint: It is ready and its passwords are already set. Nothing to fill in.
setup.dbBundledMissing: This installation has no database of its own, so you need a MySQL server of yours.
setup.dbExternalHint: A MySQL 8 or MariaDB you already run. Create the database first, and a user that can create tables in it.
setup.dbConnecting: Preparing the database. The first time can take a minute…
setup.adminHint: This account runs Rommancer: it adds users, rom folders and consoles. Every other setting already has a value that works; to change them, go to Administration > Server.
setup.mismatch: The two passwords don't match. Type them again.
setup.finish: Create the account and log in
setup.usernameHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore; 3 at least.
setup.invalidUsername: That username won't work: use at least 3 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
setup.badPort: The port has to be a number from 1 to 65535.
setup.publicUrlHint: Only if Rommancer will be reachable from the internet, for example https://roms.example.com. Consoles and phones connect through it. On a home network, leave it empty. Administration > Server changes it later.
setup.badUrl: The web address has to start with http:// or https://.
setup.romsHint: Pick the folder that holds them; if they are on several disks, one that holds them all. Rommancer reads it as it is: nothing in it is moved, renamed or deleted unless you ask.
setup.romsRestarting: Starting Rommancer with that folder. It takes a few seconds…
setup.romsFailed: Rommancer didn't start with that folder. Try again, or choose it later with rommancer.sh up.
setup.romsFixed: Your roms go in {{path}}. To use another folder later: ROMMANCER_ROMS=/other/folder rommancer.sh up

errors.db_unreachable: Nothing answers at that server and port. Check the address, that MySQL is running and that it accepts connections from this machine.
errors.db_auth: MySQL doesn't accept that user or that password.
errors.db_missing: That database doesn't exist. Create it first or type another name.
errors.db_denied: That user isn't allowed to use the database. Grant it all privileges on it.
errors.db_bundled: Rommancer's database didn't start in time. See what happened with "rommancer.sh logs mysql" and try again.

server.title: Server
server.publicUrlHint: How consoles and phones reach this server when pairing (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8096). Empty: the address each request came in on.
server.corsOriginsHint: Other websites allowed to call the API, comma-separated. Empty: only this one.
server.externalSyncHint: DATs, RetroAchievements hashes and other sources are fetched again on this schedule.
server.cronHint: minute hour day month weekday, e.g. 0 4 * * 0
server.forceSyncMin: Minutes between two forced updates of one source
server.seedOnStart: Apply the data seed on start
server.seedOnStartHint: Rommancer comes with game databases (DATs, RetroAchievements hashes, artwork) in its seed folder: this loads them when the server starts, skipping what is already there.
server.seedAutoExport: Keep the seed up to date
server.seedAutoExportHint: Writes newly imported data to the seed folder, so another server can start from it.
server.screenscraperHint: Developer credentials (ask for them on the ScreenScraper forum). Each user adds their own ScreenScraper account in their profile.
server.stored: Stored; leave empty to keep it
server.locked: Set by the server's environment; change it there

update.title: Update Rommancer
update.devHelp: This server runs from a git checkout: update it with git pull, then build and up.
update.daily: Check for a new version once a day (asks github.com)
update.safety: Before updating, the database is backed up. If the new version doesn’t start, Rommancer goes back to this one by itself, with the database as it was. Rommancer is unavailable for a few minutes while it updates.
update.confirm: Update Rommancer from {{from}} to {{to}}? It is unavailable for a few minutes.
update.noWatcher: The button needs Rommancer installed as a service. Until then, update it from the computer it runs on, in the Rommancer folder:
update.noUpdater: This server was not installed with rommancer.sh, so it can’t update itself. Update it the way it was installed; with rommancer.sh it is:
update.serviceHint: Running rommancer.sh service on once adds the button.
update.restarting: Rommancer is restarting with the new version. This page carries on by itself.

progress.rollback: Going back to the previous version

steps.queued: Waiting for the computer to start the update.
steps.build: Preparing the new version. This takes a few minutes.
steps.start: Starting the new version and applying its database changes.
steps.rollback: The new version did not start: going back to the previous one.

result.failed: The update to {{to}} failed before changing anything.
result.rolledback: {{to}} did not start, so Rommancer went back to {{from}} with the database as it was.

update.resultHelp: The log below says what happened. Rommancer keeps running as before.

gate.title: Updating Rommancer to {{to}}
gate.wait: Rommancer can’t be used until it finishes; this page carries on by itself. Don’t turn off the computer it runs on.
gate.doneHelp: Everything is as you left it.
gate.backHelp: It is back on {{version}}, as it was before. An admin can see what happened in Administration > Update.
